pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   C. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.

3. Which statement about Glaciation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Glaciation.
   B. Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Glaciation as rumours only.
   D. Say Glaciation never happens in Kenya.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

5. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Fishing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Fishing never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Fishing as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing.
   D. Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Action of wind and water in arid areas is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Action of wind and water in arid areas never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Action of wind and water in arid areas as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Action of wind and water in arid areas.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

9. Which statement about Karst Scenery is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Karst Scenery as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Karst Scenery.
   C. Say Karst Scenery never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Underground Water is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Underground Water as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Underground Water.
   C. Say Underground Water never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Action of wind and water in arid areas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Obeying laws and caring for public property

2. C — Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. B — Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. B — Explain symbols used on a map

5. A — Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. D — Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. B — Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. D — Nairobi

9. D — Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. D — Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. B — Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. C — Plan income and spending wisely

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Statistical Methods; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Elementary Surveying; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Geographic Information Systems; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Action of wind and water in arid areas; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
